questions.question: In IA-32 architecture along with the general flags, which of the following conditional flags is provided?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Along with the condition flags, the IA-32 EFLAGS register also provides TF (trap flag), IF (interrupt enable flag) and the IOPL (I/O privilege level) field. Since all three are provided, more than one option is correct.

questions.question: ISP exchanges internet traffic between their networks by
questions.explanation: ISPs exchange traffic between their networks at an Internet Exchange Point (IXP).

questions.question: The components of an expert system is/are:
questions.explanation: An expert system consists of a knowledge base, an inference engine that applies rules to the knowledge, and a user interface for interaction.

questions.question: The default color of vlink is ________.
questions.explanation: The vlink attribute of <body> sets the colour of visited links, which is purple by default. Unvisited links (link) are blue by default.

questions.question: The class of CFG is not closed under:
questions.explanation: CFLs are closed under union, concatenation and Kleene star (repeated concatenation) but not under intersection, e.g. {a^n b^n c^m} intersect {a^m b^n c^n} = {a^n b^n c^n} is not context-free.

questions.question: Which one is a DCL command in SQL?
questions.explanation: GRANT (and REVOKE) are Data Control Language commands. UPDATE and DELETE are DML and SELECT is DQL/DML.

questions.question: Which of the following is error detection code used in digital logic?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Hamming code, CRC and checksum are all used to detect errors (Hamming code can also correct single-bit errors), so more than one option is correct.

questions.question: The ALU of a computer responds to the commands coming from
questions.explanation: The control unit (control section) decodes instructions and issues commands to the ALU. Memory supplies data, not commands.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a basic operation performed on a data structure?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Basic data structure operations are traversal, search, insertion, deletion, sorting and merging. Encryption is a security operation, not a data structure operation.

questions.question: What is virtual inheritance in C++?

options.A: C++ technique to enhance multiple inheritance
options.B: C++ technique to ensure that a private member of the base class can be accessed somehow
options.C: C++ technique to avoid multiple copies of the base class into children/derived class
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Virtual inheritance ensures only one copy of a common base class is inherited in a diamond hierarchy. It does not merely 'enhance' multiple inheritance, nor give access to private members.

questions.question: How can you show or hide the grid lines in Excel Worksheet?

options.A: Go to Tools >> Options >> View tab and mark or remove the check box named Gridline
options.B: Click Gridline tool on Forms toolbar

questions.explanation: Gridlines are shown or hidden via Tools > Options > View tab > Gridlines check box. The Forms toolbar has no Gridline tool.

questions.question: _________________ uses packet switching technology to carry voice traffic over an IP network where each packet follows best route to reach its destination.
questions.explanation: VoIP carries voice as IP packets over a packet-switched network. E-mail, HTTP and SMTP are not voice-traffic technologies.

questions.question: In MySQL, which type of value should not be enclosed within quotation marks?
questions.explanation: Numeric values such as FLOAT are written without quotes. DATE, VARCHAR and CHAR values must be enclosed in quotation marks.

questions.question: It is acceptable to let long text flow into adjacent cells on a worksheet when

options.A: data will be entered in the adjacent cells
options.B: no data will be entered in the adjacent cells
options.C: there is no suitable abbreviation for the text
options.D: there is no time to format the text

questions.explanation: Long text visually overflows into adjacent cells only while those cells are empty, so it is acceptable when no data will be entered there.

questions.question: The default value of the transaction identifier in a Modbus TCP packet is?
questions.explanation: As per the official key, the transaction identifier in the Modbus TCP (MBAP) header is commonly initialized to 1 and incremented by the client to match requests with responses. The protocol identifier field, by contrast, is always 0.

questions.question:
Derive the Boolean expression for the logic circuit shown below:
A and B are inputs to an OR gate; its output is ANDed with C; that result is ANDed with D; and that result is ANDed with E to give the output.

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: OR gives (A+B), then the cascaded AND gates give C(A+B), then C(A+B)D, then C(A+B)DE. There are no inverters, so E is not complemented.

questions.question: How many edges does a spanning tree of a graph with N vertices have?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A spanning tree connects all N vertices without any cycle and therefore has exactly N-1 edges. N(N-1)/2 is the number of edges of a complete graph.

questions.question:
What is the value of the following expression?
3 + 3.00, 3**3.0
questions.explanation: The comma creates a tuple. 3 + 3.00 is 6.0 and 3**3.0 is 27.0 (a float operand gives a float result), so the value is (6.0, 27.0).

questions.question: Which of the following correctly declares an array in C++?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: int array[10]; declares an array of 10 integers. 'array{10};' has no type and 'int array;' declares a single int variable.

questions.question: UNIVAC is
questions.explanation: UNIVAC stands for UNIVersal Automatic Computer, the first commercial computer in the USA (1951).

questions.question: In an operating system, a "buffer cache" is used to:

options.B: Store copies of frequently used files in memory

questions.explanation: The buffer cache keeps copies of recently or frequently used disk blocks in main memory to reduce slow disk I/O. It does not hold the original files, the kernel or devices.

questions.question: Which of the following is an extension to the basic model of Turing machine:
questions.explanation: Multi-tape, multi-head and nondeterministic Turing machines are all extensions of the basic model, and all are equivalent in power to it.

questions.question: What does the term "Software Maintenance" refer to?
questions.explanation: Software maintenance means modifying and updating existing software after delivery to correct faults, adapt it or improve it. Developing new applications is development, not maintenance.

questions.question: Which transmission media has the highest transmission speed in a network?
questions.explanation: Optical fibre carries data as light and offers the highest bandwidth and speed among the listed media.

questions.question: Which of the following is part of the four main types for e-commerce?
questions.explanation: B2B, B2C and C2B (with C2C) are among the four main e-commerce types, so all listed options are correct.
